title: ‘Godavari’ Director Nikhil Mahajan Turns a Malegaon Carjacking Into Neo-Noir With WAVES Film Bazaar Project ‘Mongoose’
content:
ByNaman Ramachandran

Nikhil Mahajan, the Indian National Film Award-winning director of “Godavari” and the Netflix series “Betaal,” is bringing “Mongoose,” a Marathi-language neo-noir thriller about a cab driver and the con man who steals his taxi, to the Co-Production Market atWAVES Film Bazaar.

Set in the hardscrabble town of Malegaon, the film follows Abhimanyu, a hardworking driver whose hopes of owning his own taxi are wrecked when he is carjacked on the highway. The thief, Shahrukh, is a debt-ridden hustler who crashes the stolen cab, killing pilgrims traveling in a van, and the two men’s lives become violently entangled. As Abhimanyu chases justice and Shahrukh tries to stay free, it emerges that Abhimanyu’s own boss ordered the hit.

Mahajan says that, particularly since “Raavsaaheb,” he has been drawn to subjects that let him examine Indian society through a social lens, and that “Mongoose” digs into the gap between ambition and reality for one section of the population. “I choose to lend my genre sensibility to these social subjects to create a more wide appealing introspection of the Indian living condition.”

Suhrud Godbole and Mahajan’s Coquelicot Pictures is producing with Sydney-based Photoplay Films. The budget is $1.1 million, with $650,000 in place. The project is in advanced development and the team aims to start prep in the second quarter of 2027. In Goa, they are looking for co-producers, sales agents and “early-stage festival programmers.”

“At Coquelicot Pictures we are very driven and passionate about creating and supporting modern and cutting-edge storytelling. ‘Mongoose’ is a story we believe will cut across languages and demographics, and Nikhil is one of the finest genre-makers we have in the country today,” says Godbole, who has worked with Mahajan since 2011. “In Karen Radzyner we have the perfect partner to collaborate and take this film to the world.”

Radzyner leads Photoplay’s film and TV arm. The company’s films and series have competed at Berlin, Venice, Toronto, CanneSeries and SeriesFest, and its executive producer credits include “Goldstone,” “Berlin Syndrome” and “Sweet Country.”

“Nikhil’s storytelling blew me away at our first meeting in Goa two years ago and watching his festival-darling, award-winning films cemented that he’s a writer/director with soul, who alongside his impressive producer Suhrud (at Coquelicot Pictures), opens windows of insight into India for a global audience,” Radzyner says.

Mahajan’s features also include “Pune 52” and “Baji.” “Godavari” premiered at the Vancouver International Film Festival and won him the Indian National Film Award for best direction as well as a special jury award for best director at IFFI. “Betaal” was produced by Blumhouse Television and Red Chillies Entertainment. Coquelicot released “Tighee” in theaters in March.

Mahajan says he hopes audiences unfamiliar with these issues get “a ringside view of reality,” and that international viewers see “a side of India which is seldom seen.” Next up for him is a horror musical, which starts filming soon.

WAVES Film Bazaar runs as the market component of theInternational Film Festival of India(IFFI) in Goa.
title_zh: 《戈達瓦里》(Godavari) 的導演尼基爾·馬哈詹(Nikhil Mahajan)將馬雷高恩的汽車劫持事件轉化為新黑色電影風格，並在WAVES影展項目《獴》(Mongoose)中展現。
content_zh:
由納曼·拉馬昌德蘭(Naman Ramachandran)報導

印度國家電影獎得主尼基爾·馬哈詹(Nikhil Mahajan)執導的《戈達瓦里》(Godavari)及Netflix系列《貝塔爾》(Betaal)即將帶來馬拉地語的新黑色驚悚片《獴》(Mongoose)，該片講述了一名計程車司機和偷走他計程車的騙子的故事，將參加WAVES電影集市的聯合製作市場。

故事設定在艱苦的馬雷高恩鎮，影片跟隨著努力工作的司機阿比曼尤(Abhimanyu)，他的擁有計程車的夢想在高速公路上被劫車事件摧毀。小偷沙魯克(Shahrukh)是一名負債纍纍的騙子，他撞毀了偷來的計程車，導致一輛旅行車上的朝聖者喪生，兩人的生活因此暴力交織。隨著阿比曼尤追求正義，沙魯克試圖保持自由，最終揭露出阿比曼尤的老闆下令進行這次襲擊。

馬哈詹表示，自從《拉瓦薩赫布》(Raavsaaheb)以來，他一直對能讓他透過社會視角檢視印度社會的題材感興趣，而《獴》深入探討了某一部分人口之間的抱負與現實之間的差距。他說：“我選擇將我的類型敏感度應用於這些社會題材，以創造出更具廣泛吸引力的印度生活狀況的內省。”

蘇赫魯德·戈多布勒(Suhrud Godbole)和馬哈詹的科克利科特影業(Coquelicot Pictures)正在與位於悉尼的Photoplay Films合作製作。預算為110萬美元，目前已籌集65萬美元。該項目已進入高級開發階段，團隊計劃在2027年第二季度開始準備工作。在果阿，他們正在尋找聯合製作人、銷售代理和“早期階段的影展策劃人”。

戈多布勒表示：“在科克利科特影業，我們非常有動力和熱情去創造和支持現代且前衛的故事講述。《獴》是一個我們相信能跨越語言和人口統計的故事，而尼基爾是我們國內最優秀的類型導演之一。”他自2011年以來一直與馬哈詹合作。“在凱倫·拉茲納(Karen Radzyner)身上，我們找到了完美的合作夥伴，將這部電影推向全球。”

拉茲納負責Photoplay的電影和電視部門。該公司的電影和系列曾參加柏林、威尼斯、多倫多、坎城系列和SeriesFest等影展，其執行製片人名單包括《金石》(Goldstone)、《柏林綜合症》(Berlin Syndrome)和《甜蜜的國度》(Sweet Country)。

拉茲納說：“尼基爾的故事講述在我們兩年前在果阿的第一次會議中讓我驚豔，觀看他獲獎的影展寵兒電影更是證實了他是一位具有靈魂的編劇/導演，與他出色的製片人蘇赫魯德(在科克利科特影業)一起，為全球觀眾打開了了解印度的窗口。”

馬哈詹的作品還包括《普納52》(Pune 52)和《巴吉》(Baji)。影片《戈達瓦里》在溫哥華國際電影節首映，並為他贏得了最佳導演的印度國家電影獎以及在IFFI獲得的最佳導演特別評審獎。《貝塔爾》由布倫豪斯電視(Blumhouse Television)和紅辣椒娛樂(Red Chillies Entertainment)製作。科克利科特影業在三月上映了《提吉》(Tighee)。

馬哈詹(Mahajan)表示，他希望對這些議題不熟悉的觀眾能夠獲得“現實的第一手觀察”，並且希望國際觀眾能看到“印度的一面，這是很少被看到的。”接下來他將拍攝一部恐怖音樂劇，並將很快開始拍攝。

WAVES Film Bazaar作為印度國際電影節(International Film Festival of India, IFFI)在果阿的市場組成部分運行。
